newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBS HIGHER ON BUY BACKS, TALK OF INVESTOR BUYING.
newsitem.headline: JGBS HIGHER ON BUY BACKS, TALK OF INVESTOR BUYING.

text.p: The key September 10-year Japanese government bond futures contract was higher by midday on Thursday due to short-covering by dealers, traders said.
"Dealers who sold for hedging purposes yesterday following a spate of cash bond selling, bought back their shorts today," a trader for a foreign brokerage house said.
Market talk in the early morning that an investor had bought long-term cash JGBs also helped boost the market, a brokerage house trader said.
The September stood at 126.38 by midday, up from the previous day's close of 126.10. Turnover was 18,557 lots.
The benchmark 182nd JGB yield stood at 2.125 percent as of 0234 GMT, down from the previous day's close of 2.155 percent.
Even if an investor did buy cash JGBs early this morning, it probably was not in a very large lot, the first trader said.
"The buying, if it actually happened, was probably in the benchmark bond and was probably not in a very large lot," he said.
Many investors had said they would like to buy JGBs when the September is at below 126.00, the first trader said.
"Those investors haven't bought today as they are not willing to buy at current levels," he said.
Traders said they were surprised by the firmness of JGBs this morning.
"I thought JGBs would open lower this morning...but they have been surprisingly solid on the downside," a trader for a city bank's securities unit said.
Earlier, traders had said the September could make a try for around 125.80 to 125.70 on Thursday.
In the afternoon, the key futures contract may rise as high as 126.60, a trader for another foreign brokerage house said.
"I think JGBs are still on an uptrend, and that they will continue rising for a while longer," the trader said.
JGBs are likely to continue rising even if June machinery orders data and the forecast for the July-September quarter, due on Friday, come out strong, the trader said.
"I think the September will eventually make a try for 127.00," he said.
